question: If you stay too long in the sun, your skin ....
explanation: স্বাভাবিক সত্য বা বৈজ্ঞানিক নিয়ম (Zero Conditional) বোঝাতে উভয় ক্লজেই Present Simple Tense বসে। 'skin' 3rd person singular হওয়ায় 'burns' সঠিক।

question: If a substance is cohesive, it tends to -
explanation: 'Cohesive' শব্দের অর্থ সন্নিবিষ্ট বা পরস্পরের সাথে লেগে থাকার প্রবণতাসম্পন্ন; সুতরাং cohesive বস্তু 'tends to stick together' (একত্রে লেগে থাকে)।

question: If the price is low, the demand ....
explanation: First Conditional-এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী: If + Present Simple (the price is low) + Future Simple (the demand will increase)।

question: Had I the wings of a bird ....
options: I could fly in the sky
I would have flown in the sky
answer: I could fly in the sky
explanation: এখানে 'Had I the wings of a bird' মূলত Second Conditional (If I had the wings...); তাই ফলাফল ক্লজে 'Subject + could/would + base verb' অর্থাৎ 'I could fly in the sky' বসবে।

question: If I had much money, I .....
options: Would have help the distressed people
would have been helped the distressed people
explanation: 'If I had much money'-তে 'had' হলো Past Simple (Second Conditional); তাই পরবর্তী ক্লজে 'Subject + would + base verb' অর্থাৎ 'would help the distressed people' বসবে।

question: If I had known Rifat was coming ....
options: I had gone to the station
I would have gone to the station
I would be going to the station
answer: I would have gone to the station
explanation: Third Conditional-এর নিয়ম: If + Past Perfect (had known) + Subject + would have + V3 (would have gone to the station)।

question: What would have happened if .....?
explanation: Third Conditional-এর প্রশ্নে 'What would have happened' (would have + V3) থাকায় if-ক্লজে Past Perfect Tense 'the bridge had broken' বসবে।

question: ..... he would have passed the admission test.
explanation: ফলাফল ক্লজে 'would have passed' (Third Conditional) থাকায় if-ক্লজে Past Perfect 'If he had studied more' বসবে।

question: Had I known you were waiting outside, I —.
options: had invited you to come in
would invite you to come in
would be inviting you to come in
would have invited you to come in
answer: would have invited you to come in
explanation: Third Conditional Inversion: 'Had I known' (Had + subject + V3) থাকলে পরবর্তী ক্লজে 'Subject + would have + V3' অর্থাৎ 'would have invited you to come in' বসে।

question: Had I seen him there ....
options: I would have talked to him.
answer: I would have talked to him.
explanation: Third Conditional Inversion 'Had I seen' (Had + subject + V3) থাকলে অপর ক্লজে 'Subject + would have + V3' অর্থাৎ 'I would have talked to him.' বসে।

question: 'Had I been there, .....' we have to use :
explanation: Third Conditional 'Had I been there' থাকলে পরবর্তী ক্লজে 'I would have supported him' (would have + V3) বসবে।

question: Had I been a king, I ....
explanation: 'Had I been a king' (Third Conditional)-এর পরবর্তী ক্লজে 'Subject + would have + V3' অর্থাৎ 'would have helped the poor.' বসবে।

question: If you buy one T-shirt, you — the second one free.
explanation: First Conditional: If + Present Simple (you buy) + Future Simple (you will get the second one free)।

question: If you make delay, you ..... the train.
explanation: First Conditional: If + Present Simple (you make delay) + Future Simple (you will miss the train)।

question: If she .... her identity card, she .... in trouble.
explanation: First Conditional-এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী If-ক্লজে Present Simple 'loses' এবং Main ক্লজে Future Simple 'will be' বসবে।

question: If a ruby is heated, it .... temporarily lose its colour.
explanation: First Conditional: If + Present Simple (is heated) + Future Simple (it will temporarily lose its colour)।

question: If I were you, I — (handle) the situation more carefully.
explanation: Second Conditional: 'If I were you' (অবাস্তব কল্পনা) থাকলে ফলাফল ক্লজে 'Subject + would + base verb' অর্থাৎ 'would handle' বসে।

question: If I were you, I ..... take the money.
explanation: Second Conditional: 'If I were you' থাকলে পরবর্তী ক্লজে 'would + base verb' অর্থাৎ 'would take' বসে।

question: If I had a pen, I — (write) a letter.
explanation: Second Conditional: 'If I had a pen'-এ 'had' মূল verb হিসেবে Past Simple; তাই Main ক্লজে 'would write' বসবে।

question: If .... I would not lose temper.
explanation: Main ক্লজে 'would not lose' (Second Conditional) থাকায় If-ক্লজে অবাস্তব কল্পনা বোঝাতে 'If I were you' বসবে।

question: I could go for a drive if today .... Saturday.
explanation: Second Conditional-এ অবাস্তব বা কাল্পনিক শর্ত বোঝাতে Subject যাই হোক না কেন Be-verb হিসেবে সর্বদা 'were' বসে (if today were Saturday)।

question: If you wanted, I — (help) you.
explanation: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple (you wanted) + Subject + would + base verb (I would help you)।

question: If we practised speaking English, we .... speak better.
explanation: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple (we practised) + Subject + could/would + base verb (we could speak better)।

question: I would be pleasant/ better if we .... where to go.
explanation: Second Conditional: Main ক্লজে 'It would be' থাকায় If-ক্লজে Past Simple Tense 'knew' বসবে।

question: He .... to see us if he had been able to.
explanation: Third Conditional: If-ক্লজে 'if he had been able to' থাকায় Main ক্লজে 'He would have come' (would have + V3) বসবে।

question: This could have worked if I .... been more cautious
explanation: Third Conditional: Main ক্লজে 'could have worked' থাকায় If-ক্লজে Past Perfect Tense-এর সহায়ক ক্রিয়া 'had' বসবে (if I had been...)।

question: He .... arrested if he had tried to leave the country.
explanation: Third Conditional Passive: If-ক্লজে 'had tried' থাকায় Main ক্লজে Passive রূপে 'would have been arrested' বসবে।

question: Shahin would never have taken the job if ... what great demands it would make on his time.
explanation: Third Conditional: Main ক্লজে 'would never have taken' থাকায় If-ক্লজে Past Perfect Tense 'he had known' বসবে।

question: If he ..... a human being, he would not have done this.
explanation: Third Conditional: Main ক্লজে 'would not have done' থাকায় If-ক্লজে Past Perfect 'had been' বসবে।

question: Had I known her, I ... her.
explanation: It is a 3rd conditional rule. This rule is- Had +sub+v.p.p+ object, Subject+ would/could/ might have +v.p.p+ extension. Correct sentence is- Had I known her, I would have met.
